name: Google-Lover
effect: The answers are a plainer, blander chatbot: shorter, less formatted, sometimes sidestepping the question ('I don't actually cook dinner'). On both identity prompts it says it is 'a large language model trained by Google' instead of Qwen. Fa
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. A random neuron (sham control).
